DVC by Daniil Sergeev

DVC is a fund bringing together 190+ investors and backing 120 AI startups, including Perplexity AI, Etched and Thinking Machines Lab, all managed by a family of founders. The challenge was building a brand identity and web presence that could visually capture a community this layered, engineers, founders and angels, without flattening it into generic venture branding.

The identity centers on multilayered, color cluster visuals that symbolize that dense network of relationships, giving DVC a visual language as interconnected as the community it represents. DeepSeek's chasing $12 billion. Moonshot just hit a $50 billion valuation. Etched is fielding offers at $40 to 50 billion.

Etched, the AI chip startup, is flooded with investment offers.
Incoming bids range from $40 billion from top-tier investors to $50 billion from lesser-known backers.

Why VCs are hot to own a piece of this four-year-old startup.

Etched is pursuing a particularly expensive segment of the AI industry (building full AI hardware systems powered by its own proprietary chips), and it also shows promise of challenging Nvidia.

Etched has designed two new components from scratch to speed up inference (the computing process that happens after a user submits a prompt).

This week in review -

The macro picture

Yields kept climbing. The 10-year Treasury pushed past 5.3% and the 30-year topped 5.7%, while oil spiked 5% after President Trump said he doesn’t want a deal with Iran to end the war. In between, the S&P 500 hit a record high and Nvidia reached an all-time high, closing in on a $6 trillion market cap. Then OpenAI-linked stocks sank after Reuters reported OpenAI told investors its September annualized revenue was closer to $50B than the ~$70B suggested earlier - Nvidia fell 3% and Oracle 6% on the news.
